about_item: 【UCANBE Athena Face & Body Paint | 12 Colors Basic Palette】UCANBE Athena Face Paint Palette(Basic Version)includes 12 essential classic bold shades- ghost white, jet black, vampire red, creepy clown pink, witch purple, pumpkin orange, zombie moss green, neon lime green, bright yellow, werewolf brown, sally blue and navy blue. Designed with EXTRA-LARGE BLACK & WHITE PANS, giving you more of the essential shades that are used frequently for outlines, highlights, shadows, mixing, details and full-face designs.

【Classic Color Selection | Versatile & No Wasted Shades】In this painting palette, each color is carefully selected to improve shade usability, helping every pan serve a real makeup purpose. It’s ideal for flash tattoos, artistic makeup, special effects makeup and other character looks such as clown, Joker, witch, skeleton/skull, devil, zombie, vampire, monster, goth makeup and more. Designed especially for Halloween costume cosplay, themed parties, pride or 4th July parade, carnivals, festivals, stage & theater performances, and of course also sports games fan face painting!

【Oil-Based Cream Face Paint | Blendable & Buildable】The oil-based cream texture glides smoothly, delivers rich color payoff, and helps create even and buildable full coverage. It glides easily, blends well, and is designed to stay flexible on the skin, helping reduce cracking, smudging, and fading during wear. Vibrant Colors can be layered, blended, and mixed freely to create custom shades for creative makeup looks. Tip: Mix black and white to create gray.

【Vibrant Colors for SFX Makeup | Safe & Non-toxic】All UCANBE oil face paints are manufactured using cosmetic-grade quality ingredients, non-toxic and gentle on skin, suitable for all skin types of all ages. BUT still, As everyone's skin type is different, we recommend that all cosmetics are tested on a small patch of skin before use.

【Easy to Use and Remove | Long Lasting Makeup】USAGE- Start with clean, dry face; Apply primer and let it dry before makeup; Pick up the color directly with sponges，painting brushes or fingertips, then apply evenly to the face or body. Set with translucent powder for longer-lasting, transfer-resistant wear. REMOVAL- gently wipe off with cleansing oil, cleansing balm or a professional waterproof makeup remover, and wash with soap and water.

summary.text: Customers find the face paint palette very pigmented and vibrant, with one noting it doesn't stain the face. The product is easy to apply, works well, and customers consider it worth the price point. They appreciate its versatility, with one mentioning it's great for scar makeup. The removal experience is mixed - while some find it easy to remove, others report it's extremely difficult to remove.
